dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent pale edges create a sharp, high-contrast boundary against the dark grey-brown centers of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, light-colored identification band is visible encircling the right tarsus.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive, high-contrast scaly pattern across the entire dorsal surface, including crown, mantle, wing coverts, and tail rectrices.
